items.source: The unit prefixes used in this class are binary prefixes indicating multiplication by powers of 2. The following table displays the enum constants defined in this class and corresponding values.

items.source: Bytes, represented by suffix B.

items.source: Kilobytes, represented by suffix KB.
items.translation: 千字节，由后缀 KB 表示。

items.source: Megabytes, represented by suffix MB.
items.translation: 兆字节，后缀为MB。

items.source: Terabytes, represented by suffix TB.
